_readme: ALL landing-page words and brand tokens live here. landing/index.html is a generic renderer: for a new app, copy this folder, replace this file + pricing/plans.json + the images, done. Copy rules: no guaranteed outcomes, no invented numbers or testimonials, no competitor names, plain words, feeling before mechanism. Marketing principles used: StoryBrand (the visitor is the hero, Clar the guide), Schwartz awareness stages (start from the feeling they already have), Cialdini (reciprocity = free plan, commitment = 'one minute', unity, honest authority), Hormozi value equation (clear outcome, low effort, fast first win), Ogilvy/Sugarman (one big idea, slippery-slide short lines), risk reversal (free, no card, cancel anytime, delete your data yourself).

honest.title: What Clar is not.
items: Not therapy and not medical advice.
Not a promise of results. Results come from you showing up.
Not a feed designed to keep you hooked.
honest.close: It is a set of daily practices and a thoughtful companion. What you do with it is yours.

faq.a: Yes. The free plan has the daily habit tools, a limited number of Clar AI messages each day and the Community. Paid plans add more of everything.
No. Clar is a self-development companion, not therapy or medical care. If you are struggling, please speak to a qualified professional.

faq.q: What does Clar do with my data?
faq.a: Your data is used to run the app for you. You can delete your account and data yourself, from inside the app, any time. Read the privacy page for details.

faq.q: How does XP lower the price?
faq.a: You earn XP by using Clar on steady days. At renewal your XP gives you a discount: up to 50% on Plus and up to 25% on Pro. XP is never spent, so your level and streak stay.

faq.q: Do I need a card to start?
faq.a: No. Start free, with no card and no trial clock.
Any time. No questions, no tricks.
Clar runs in your browser on any phone or computer, and installs like an app.

roots.title: Old wisdom. Modern psychology. No hype.
roots.text: Clar draws on timeless teachings about attention, desire and inner stillness, and on well-known ideas from psychology: small habits, reframing a story, visualising a goal, practising calm. It never promises an outcome. It gives you the practice.
